name: Figures IV-10 and IV-11: price dispersion vs lifetime
description: Figures IV-10 and IV-11: the standard deviation of ln(trade price) per tick, averaged over 50-tick blocks, in iv-3-trade with finite lives and replacement, for lifetimes 60–100 and 960–1000. Seeds 1–10. Measured (release, seeds 1–10): lifetimes 60–100 mean sd(ln price) 0.502 in the first block (t=50) and 0.444 in the last (t=1000); lifetimes 960–1000 mean sd(ln price) 0.502 in the first block and 0.138 in the last.
